title: Pega Developer
summary: A Pega developer builds business workflow applications, such as loan approvals or insurance claims, on the Pega low-code platform. They usually sit in a delivery team at a bank, insurer or IT services company, working with business analysts, Pega architects and testers.
dailyDuties: Build case types, flows and UI screens from user stories
Configure data pages, data transforms and activities
Connect the application to other systems through REST or SOAP
Debug issues with the Tracer and fix defects from testing
Review rules and guardrail warnings before deployment
Join sprint planning and daily stand-ups

skills.expectation: Build applications in Pega Infinity with rules, data pages, data transforms and activities
Design case types, stages, flows and parent-child cases
Read and write Java for custom functions and debugging
Query and tune the database behind Pega reports and data pages
Connect Pega to other systems with REST connectors and services
Deliver user stories in Scrum sprints
Talk through designs with business analysts and testers
Build next-best-action strategies in Customer Decision Hub
Customise Pega UI sections with JavaScript
Know banking or insurance processes, where most Pega work is
Move rules through environments with deployment pipelines

certifications.why: Indian Pega postings usually make the System Architect certification mandatory.
Senior System Architect is asked for in most mid-level Pega postings.

sources.description: Drafted by CareerMetro from public India job descriptions and issuer outlines on 2026-10-30. Awaiting domain-expert review.
